description: This Java class 'RemotePlayer' manages media playback via a remote media route using the Android support library. It includes methods for connecting to routes, controlling playback (play, pause, resume, stop), handling queuing of media items, and updating playback statistics. It interfaces with the 'RemotePlaybackClient' and listens for session and item status changes, providing a backend for media streaming to remote devices.

classes.name: RemotePlayer
classes.description: Handles remote media playback, including connection management, playback control, session handling, and statistics gathering.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playing a media item on the connected remote route.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within a media item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a media item.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and ends the session if supported.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a media item for remote playback; throws if queuing is unsupported.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the queue by item ID.

methods.name: updateStatistics
methods.description: Requests statistics data from the remote route.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns the last fetched statistics information.
